name: AlienVault OTX (indicator API)
tier_rationale: LevelBlue (formerly AT&T Cybersecurity) is an established security company with published terms and a business offering (A8 trusted); P153 cond 3 'Registry provider otx (LevelBlue): tier trusted' and P304 cond 5 'trusted - ... OTX'.

reliability.justification: Community threat-intel pulses of uneven quality: pulse membership is not a verdict (P153 cond 5); malicious only with >= 2 pulses from distinct authors modified in the last 365 days or 1 pulse by the AlienVault/LevelBlue labs account.

otx.plan_hint: business = a company OTX account whose terms legal recorded as permitting internal business use (key_plans.otx='business', or free_plan_business_use recorded, P153 cond 3)

indicators.title: OTX indicator API v1 (general, reputation, geo, malware, url_list, passive_dns, http_scans per IPv4/IPv6/domain/hostname/url/file/cve)

terms.quote: Terms: the OTX terms page is JS-only and was not verified (2026-11-26): legal records the OTX terms for a company account; source class 'key-terms', so under corporate it runs only with free_plan_business_use=true or key_plans.otx='business'.

indicators.notes: Quote: binding council text (P153 cond 3); P060 (url_list use) is 'open' and the strictest class applies. Research C0324 terms '[gh_cti_ioc] LevelBlue/AT&T OTX terms (free community)' (verified_live 200). otx.alienvault.com/api/v1/indicators/{IPv4|IPv6|domain|hostname|url|file|cve}/{value}/{general|reputation|geo|malware|url_list|passive_dns|http_scans}; read-only, never create pulses or submit indicators (P153 cond 2). otx needs the key; otx_keyless uses 'general' only (default off, P153 cond 1). 403 with a key = NEEDS_KEY; 429 = RATE_LIMITED, never 'not listed' (P153 cond 4). embeds abuse.ch: pulses relaying abuse.ch count as the abuse.ch upstream family (P153 cond 6, P171). Used by otx and otx_keyless (P060 cond 1 dropped OTX from archive_mining's hosts).

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G07-1, p2-G01-3 (P060, P153): batches only extend it (otx__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Quota: a free key allows about 10,000 requests per hour (research C0324 live_cti, observed) -> key budget at 80%; anonymous passive_dns answers 429 'Anonymous access to this endpoint is limited' (RATE_LIMITED, never absent). http_profile: timeout 20 s (the deep preset's 60 s is set by the module), max_bytes 5 MB (truncated = partial, never complete), ttl 24 h (P153 cond 4). No error markers yet: the owning batch adds them with the trimmed real fixtures P153 cond 8 lists (general 8.8.8.8, a domain with pulses, keyless passive_dns 429, bad-key 403).
